Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application.port

Class CorruptedRecordException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application.port.RepositoryException
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.application.port.CorruptedRecordException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class CorruptedRecordException extends RepositoryException
Thrown when one record in the archive cannot be read back into a highlight.

It names the record that failed, not the file: the archive should not be lost because a single line is malformed. It carries the highlights that did load, so the caller can report the damage and carry on with the rest. Pass the parse failure as the cause — dropping it throws away the only explanation of what the line actually said.
